2. **Filter Activity feed by recruiter name** — "show only Shreya's activity"  
3. **Last active date on Members tab** — show when each member was last active
4. **Performance scores on Overview tab** — per-recruiter stats (resumes reviewed, candidates moved, tasks completed)

content.content:
-- ============================================================
-- ACTIVITY LOG
-- ============================================================
-- Depends on:
--   • public.teams, public.team_members        (20260407100000)
--   • public.tasks                             (20260407200000)
--   • public.jobs, public.resumes              (initial schema)
--   • public.candidate_notes                   (20260407100000)
--   • public.applications                      (20260404000000)
--   • public.is_team_member()                  (20260407100000)
-- ============================================================


-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. TABLE
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE public.activity_log (
  id          uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  team_id     uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  actor_id    uuid        REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  action      text        NOT NULL,
  entity_type text,
  entity_id   uuid,
  metadata    jsonb       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Indexes
CREATE INDEX idx_activity_log_team_time   ON public.activity_log(team_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_activity_log_team_action ON public.activity_log(team_id, action);


-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 2. RLS
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ALTER TABLE public.activity_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Team members can read their team's activity
CREATE POLICY "Team members can view activity"
  ON public.activity_log FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (public.is_team_member(auth.uid(), team_id));

-- Allow SECURITY DEFINER trigger functions to insert without JWT check
CREATE POLICY "Triggers can insert activity"
  ON public.activity_log FOR INSERT TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (true);

-- Also allow service_role (used by triggers running as SECURITY DEFINER)
CREATE POLICY "Service role can insert activity"
  ON public.activity_log FOR INSERT TO service_role
  WITH CHECK (true);


-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 3. REALTIME
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.activity_log;


-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 4. TRIGGER FUNCTIONS
-- Each is SECURITY DEFINER so it can INSERT into activity_log
-- regardless of the calling user's RLS policies.
-- All wrapped in EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS to never block the main op.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- ── 4a. Member joined ────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_member_joined()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.activity_log (team_id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, metadata)
    VALUES (
      NEW.team_id,
      NEW.user_id,
      'member_joined',
      'team_member',
      NEW.id,
      '{}'::jsonb
    );
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    NULL;
  END;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_log_member_joined
  AFTER INSERT ON public.team_members
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.log_member_joined();


-- ── 4b. Task created ─────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_task_created()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.activity_log (team_id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, metadata)
    VALUES (
      NEW.team_id,
      NEW.created_by,
      'task_created',
      'task',
      NEW.id,
      jsonb_build_object('title', NEW.title, 'job_id', NEW.job_id)
    );
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    NULL;
  END;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_log_task_created
  AFTER INSERT ON public.tasks
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.log_task_created();


-- ── 4c. Task completed ───────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_task_completed()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status = 'done' AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'done' THEN
    BEGIN
      INSERT INTO public.activity_log (team_id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, metadata)
      VALUES (
        NEW.team_id,
        NEW.created_by,
        'task_completed',
        'task',
        NEW.id,
        jsonb_build_object('title', NEW.title)
      );
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
      NULL;
    END;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_log_task_completed
  AFTER UPDATE OF status ON public.tasks
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.log_task_completed();


-- ── 4d. Note added ───────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_note_added()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  _team_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Look up team_id from the related job
  SELECT j.team_id INTO _team_id
  FROM public.jobs j
  WHERE j.id = NEW.job_id;

  IF _team_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.activity_log (team_id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, metadata)
    VALUES (
      _team_id,
      NEW.author_id,
      'note_added',
      'candidate_note',
      NEW.id,
      jsonb_build_object('job_id', NEW.job_id, 'resume_id', NEW.resume_id)
    );
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    NULL;
  END;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_log_note_added
  AFTER INSERT ON public.candidate_notes
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.log_note_added();


-- ── 4e. Application received ─────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_application_received()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  _team_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Look up team_id from the related job
  SELECT j.team_id INTO _team_id
  FROM public.jobs j
  WHERE j.id = NEW.job_id;

  IF _team_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.activity_log (team_id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, metadata)
    VALUES (
      _team_id,
      NULL,  -- applications come from unauthenticated candidates
      'application_received',
      'application',
      NEW.id,
      jsonb_build_object('name', NEW.name, 'job_id', NEW.job_id)
    );
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    NULL;
  END;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_log_application_received
  AFTER INSERT ON public.applications
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.log_application_received();


-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 5. COMMENTS
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

COMMENT ON TABLE public.activity_log IS 'Team-scoped audit log. Populated by SECURITY DEFINER triggers on team_members, tasks, candidate_notes, and applications.';
COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.log_member_joined()          IS 'Logs member_joined when a user joins a team.';
COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.log_task_created()           IS 'Logs task_created when a task is inserted.';
COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.log_task_completed()         IS 'Logs task_completed when a task transitions to done.';
COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.log_note_added()             IS 'Logs note_added when a candidate note is inserted.';
COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.log_application_received()   IS 'Logs application_received when a new application is inserted (actor_id is NULL for anon submitters).';

content.content:
-- ============================================================
-- MENTIONS SUPPORT FOR CANDIDATE NOTES
-- ============================================================
-- Depends on:
--   • public.candidate_notes            (20260407100000)
--   • public.notifications              (20260331000000)
--   • public.jobs                       (initial schema)
-- ============================================================

-- Add mentions column to candidate_notes
ALTER TABLE public.candidate_notes ADD COLUMN mentions uuid[] DEFAULT '{}';

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Extend notifications type constraint to include 'mention'
-- (Drop the one added by 20260407200000 and recreate with mention)
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ALTER TABLE public.notifications DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS notifications_type_check;

ALTER TABLE public.notifications ADD CONSTRAINT notifications_type_check
  CHECK (type IN (
    'ranking_complete',
    'ranking_failed',
    'credits_low',
    'credits_added',
    'system',
    'stage_changed',
    'note_added',
    'task_assigned',
    'task_completed',
    'member_joined',
    'mention'
  ));

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Trigger function: notify mentioned users on note insert
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_mentions()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  mentioned_id uuid;
  job_title    text;
BEGIN
  -- Skip if no mentions or empty array
  IF NEW.mentions IS NULL OR array_length(NEW.mentions, 1) IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- Get job title for the notification message
  SELECT j.title INTO job_title
  FROM   public.jobs j
  WHERE  j.id = NEW.job_id;

  -- Create a notification for each mentioned user (excluding the note author)
  FOREACH mentioned_id IN ARRAY NEW.mentions
  LOOP
    IF mentioned_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.author_id THEN
      BEGIN
        INSERT INTO public.notifications (user_id, type, title, message, metadata)
        VALUES (
          mentioned_id,
          'mention',
          'You were mentioned in a note',
          'Someone mentioned you in a note on ' || COALESCE(job_title, 'a job'),
          jsonb_build_object(
            'job_id',    NEW.job_id,
            'resume_id', NEW.resume_id,
            'note_id',   NEW.id
          )
        );
      EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
        -- Never block note creation due to notification failure
        NULL;
      END;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER on_note_mention
  AFTER INSERT ON public.candidate_notes
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.notify_mentions();

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.notify_mentions() IS 'Creates mention notifications for each user mentioned in a candidate note, skipping the note author.';
